summary: Added a pure, disabled-by-default MCP launch-queue CONTRACT module launch_queue_contract.py: defines the launch-request, process-state, process-log, and result-handoff schemas; represents/enqueues launch INTENTS; checks explicit env gates (AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH + AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES, both default '0' = disabled); and offers dry-run description only. It launches NOTHING: no subprocess/exec/fork/shell code, no network/API call, and no env flag can start a process because LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED is a constant False. attempt_start() ALWAYS raises LaunchDisabledError. describe_intent()/evaluate_launch()/enqueue_intent() are side-effect-free (write nothing to disk); persistence + audit are deferred to the gated phase. workflow_switch and parent-queue mutation stay False.

invariant.launch_enable_flag_has_no_effect_in_this: even AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1 AND AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES=1 cannot start a process; no launcher exists here (LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED=False)

public_api.describe_intent(request, audit=False): dry-run dict (intent+decision+gate_status); side-effect-free; audit=True refuses (no writer)
public_api.attempt_start(request): ALWAYS raises LaunchDisabledError; spawns nothing, even with both gates on
public_api.build_log_entry(request, decision): ProcessLogEntry shape; env as NAME->status tokens only; not written
public_api.env_gates_open(): True only when BOTH gates == '1' (describes future permission; does not act)

neural_bridge_note: Static command/adapter allowlists are human-configured SAFETY boundaries, not a runtime cue router. Future adapter/runner/topic launch selection must become a LEARNED routing + abstain policy tracked as MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1; no regex/keyword cognition becomes launch authority.
no_launch_code_marker: This module and its tests contain NO process-launch code: no subprocess import, no child-process spawn, no os-level exec/fork, no shell invocation, no network/API call. Launch/process code arrives only in the gated Phase-2 follow-up (CLAUDE_TASK_MCP_ORCH_GATED_ENABLEMENT_B106_V1) behind all launch_preconditions.
